S0910.reason: Solutrean assemblages are defined by fine laurel-leaf stone points, and the following Magdalenian tradition is defined by bone and antler work.

S0390.reason: The hydrogen line is at a shorter wavelength than the lab value, a blueshift that means the star is approaching.

S0606.reason: Non-matching early and modern skulls was taken to mean later Native American populations did not descend from those first migrants.

S0851.reason: Spirit is in Mars’s southern hemisphere, so in winter the sun stays in the northern sky and the rover was tilted north to face it.

S0460.reason: Prograde spin and orbit periods are equal, so the same face keeps pointing at the sun and there is no solar day.
